test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

The man who / was committed / the theft last night / was caught this evening.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'was committed'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **'committed**' should be used instead of **'was committed'.**
 
• The error in the given sentence is that the verb "was committed" is in the passive voice, which means that it is unclear who committed the theft. To correct the sentence, the passive voice should be changed to the active voice 'committed'.
 
• The verb "**commit**" is a regular verb, which means that it follows the typical **conjugation** pattern for English verbs. In the **past simple tense**, the verb "**commit**" takes the form "**committed**." In the past participle form, the verb "**commit**" also takes the form "**committed**."
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 2.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__*** The man who __**committed**__ the theft last night was caught this evening.*
